sections.label: Pigeon feeding and nuisance complaints
sections.summary: Most complaints concern pigeons, particularly public feeding of pigeons and pigeon nuisance generally.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The vast majority pertain to pigeons, especially the feeding of pigeons, by the public and pigeon nuisance in general.

sections.label: Clearing leftover food in hawker centres
sections.summary: NEA works with Town Councils and table-cleaning contractors to clear leftover food in hawker centres quickly.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: To minimise this, the National Environment Agency (NEA) works with Town Councils and table-cleaning contractors to clear leftover food in hawker centres as quickly as possible.

sections.label: Bird deterrent measures by NEA, AVA, Town Councils
sections.summary: NEA and Town Councils adopt bird-deterring hawker centre designs, while AVA works with Town Councils on bird population measures including gels, contraceptives and fogging.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Besides removing leftover food, NEA and Town Councils have been progressively adopting designs that deter birds for hawker centres, such as bird spikes and bird wires on ceiling beams, to prevent birds from perching in these areas.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For residential estates, AVA has been working with Town Councils on measures to manage the bird population.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: These include the use of bird deterrent gels, oral contraceptives for the pigeons, and fogging trees to deter mynahs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For example, AVA worked with Choa Chu Kang Town Council on a bird deterrent gel trial from February 2015.

sections.label: Palmer Road nicarbazin feed trial
sections.summary: In October 2015 AVA began a year-long Palmer Road trial of a corn-based feed containing nicarbazin, an oral contraceptive.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In October 2015, AVA embarked on a year-long trial at Palmer Road to test the effectiveness of a corn-based feed that contains nicarbazin, which is an oral contraceptive.

sections.label: Chicken versus pigeon transmission risk
sections.summary: Chickens have a higher risk of transmission than pigeons, not the reverse.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Chickens have a higher risk of transmission compared to pigeons, not the other way round.

sections.label: Bird flu surveillance and possible culling
sections.summary: Surveillance covers bird types and migratory patterns; culling of pigeons, mynahs or crows may be stepped up if risk is high, but not one-size-fits-all now.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: At this point in time, we are conducting background surveillance on the types of birds and whether they are migratory, and what is the migratory pattern of birds that go through the Singapore flyway.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: If we perceive that the risk is high and there are actually monitored instances of more bird flu occurring around the region, close to home, for example, or if the migratory pattern of birds that come to our shore carries some strains of the bird flu virus, then, yes, we may have to step up even more aggressively in culling, whether it is pigeons, mynahs or crows, to reduce the risk of birds within this area that carry the viruses.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: But today, if we were to take a one-size-fits-all approach, then we will be unnecessarily culling pigeons and mynahs when the risk of bird flu infection may not be high at this point in time.

sections.label: Technology to catch feeding
sections.summary: Measures other than human patrols to catch people feeding could include technology such as surveillance cameras.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Some of the measures that can be employed, other than using actual human beings walking around to catch people feeding, could be to use the deployment of technology, such as surveillance cameras.
